THE DIRECTIONS

You will talk to four people. Record what you would say to each one. You can record again as many times as you want. When all four are recorded, click Submit.

THE SCENE

You host the school podcast. You are alone in the recording room and were given an empty schedule. You need four different times to fill the one hour podcast schedule. Four people each can help you.

THE HISTORY

This podcast is about Ziryab, a singer from Baghdad. He moved to Spain in 822. He added a fifth string to the oud. He started the first school for music.
